statements.subject: client
statements.description: If the UAC supports extensions to SIP that can be applied by the server to the response, the UAC SHOULD include a Supported header field in the request listing the option tags (Section 19.2) for those extensions.
actions: include Supported header field in request listing option tags for supported extensions

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The option tags listed MUST only refer to extensions defined in standards-track RFCs.

statements.subject: client
statements.description: If the UAC wishes to insist that a UAS understand an extension that the UAC will apply to the request in order to process the request, it MUST insert a Require header field into the request listing the option tag for that extension.
actions: insert Require header field into request listing option tag for required extension

statements.subject: client
statements.description: If the UAC wishes to apply an extension to the request and insist that any proxies that are traversed understand that extension, it MUST insert a Proxy-Require header field into the request listing the option tag for that extension.
actions: insert Proxy-Require header field into request listing option tag for required extension

statements.subject: message
statements.description: As with the Supported header field, the option tags in the Require and Proxy-Require header fields MUST only refer to extensions defined in standards-track RFCs.
